jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(A) inventory: Peacham School District, a town school district in the Caledonia Central Supervisory Union (member town: Peacham). Operates PK-6; tuitions grades 7-12.

board.post_note: Peacham SD: five directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b).

sources.note: Peacham SD board members page (official, fetched 2026-10-22): Hibbert (Chair) expires 2027; Clough (Vice Chair) 2027; Maclean 2028; Dedam 2028; Devine (Clerk) 2029. The board has five directors (section 423 as expanded under 423(b); the expansion vote itself was not fetched). The Town of Peacham's school-board page is STALE (it lists Diana Senturia in Dedam's seat and Clough as chair, while the district's Oct. 5, 2026 minutes show Hibbert chairing) -- the district page governs. Resolving documents for the Dedam flag: the Peacham School Meeting Minutes 2026 and any spring-fall 2026 appointment minutes (both town-posted PDFs failed text extraction this session).
